text:
sre-bot: PAGER: sev2 -> inference-eu-west-2a: elevated 5xx and network error spikes across g5 inference nodes. Auto-runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/az-network-degen. Paging: @emma (oncall)

emma (oncall): acknowledging. I'm seeing a flood of ENI detach/attach and TCP retransmits from hosts in eu-west-2a. App-layer 5xx correlated with net drops. Starting live triage.

raj (infra): confirmed on our side — multiple host NIC resets across the autoscaling group, metrics show RX err and carrier changes. AWS console shows ENI flaps on ~6/24 nodes. Suspect a host-level NIC firmware or hypervisor networking issue in the AZ.

ines (product-sre): @emma can you estimate customer impact? Which serving pools are affected (hosted vs dedicated)?

emma (oncall): quick assessment: hosted routing observed ~20% of requests hitting eu-west-2a had increased p99 from 120ms->800ms and 5xx rose from 0.4%->6.2%. Dedicated customers pinned to eu-west-2a: two heavy-throughput tenants (cust-a, cust-b) are seeing errors and queued requests. I'll pull the customer list.

support-eng: I'm drafting an internal note for CS; @marta can you prep a holding message if we need to escalate?

marta (customer-success): on it — short hold: "We're investigating intermittent network errors affecting model responses in London region. We'll share updates soon."

emma (oncall): mitigation plan proposal: 1) enable smart-routing fallback to prefer eu-west-1 pools for non-pinned hosted traffic, 2) for Dedicated pinned customers, open support tickets and offer traffic migration (if they allow), 3) cordon/drain affected nodes and mark ASG unhealthy to force replacement. Any objections?

raj (infra): for (1) we can flip the routing policy to prefer cross-az->cross-region fallback. Changing routing weight to prefer eu-west-1 adds ~40ms median — OK for most hosted traffic. I'll prepare the rollout script. For (3) I recommend gradual drain to avoid cascading evictions; we should also disable instance replacement until we confirm ENI stability.

deploy-bot: ENV change request queued: routing-policy.update -> prefer-eu-west-1 (change id: 20260315-0923). Approve with \`/deploy approve 20260315-0923\`

emma (oncall): approving now. /deploy approve 20260315-0923. Executing routing change — will monitor error rates.

[2m later]

emma (oncall): routing change applied. Initial signal: hosted 5xx dropped from 6.2% -> 1.1% within 60s for flows that were eligible for fallback. Dedicated pinned customers still impacted.

ines (product-sre): for dedicated customers, we should run immediate opt-in traffic migration if they accept potential model-version mismatch and brief downtime window. Can you list candidates?

emma (oncall): cust-a and cust-b are pinned. cust-a accepts migration in-app if offered, cust-b needs approval. I'll spin up temporary cross-region replicas and coordinate with SEs.

raj (infra): starting node cordon/drain on the worst hosts. Logs attached:

Mar 15 09:23:21 host-g5-12 kernel: net_eth0: link reset, carrier lost
Mar 15 09:23:22 host-g5-12 hypervisor: eni-attach: error code=ENI_RESET
Mar 15 09:23:22 host-g5-12 inference-runtime: kv-cache reconnect failed: EOF

support-eng: CS informed for cust-a. Creating ticket for cust-b.

marta (customer-success): cust-a acknowledged and accepted migration. Preparing handoff to SE for cutover.

[~15m later]

emma (oncall): update: drained 8 hosts, replacement instances coming up but we're holding autoscaling until we see ENI stability for 30m. Hosted fallback remains healthy, 5xx ~0.8%. Dedicated: cust-a migrated to eu-west-1 replica — seeing normal traffic. cust-b still impacted; SE pinged.

raj (infra): opened support case with AWS for host NIC/network plane in eu-west-2a: case #123456789. They acknowledged potential zonal network fabric issue and are investigating underlying hypervisor/host patching.

deploy-bot: monitor rule created: monitor/inference-5xx-eu-west-2a -> alert if 5xx > 1% sustained 5m after routing fallback.

ines (product-sre): file for post-incident: root cause candidates (host NIC/hypervisor network plane), mitigations taken (routing fallback, node drain, customer migrations), customer impact summary, timeline, and follow-ups (AWS RCA, improve cross-az fallback automation, pre-approved migration runbook).

emma (oncall): marking incident as active/mitigated. I'll hand off to next oncall in 30m and create a short incident summary. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

marta (customer-success): leaving a note for postmortem: cust-b required manual approval -> delayed mitigation. Will include impact details.

sre-bot: Incident status update posted to #incidents-log and PagerDuty. Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring.

emma (oncall): handoff to @next-oncall in 30m — leaving all runbook links and AWS case id in the incident doc. Closing updates in 1h unless signal regresses.

[thread closed]
